description: This file contains unit tests for the StateTrigger class in the WPEFramework Core namespace, testing state transitions and wait mechanisms.

classes.name: StateTrigger<TestState>
classes.description: A template class used to manage and trigger state changes, tested here with the TestState enum.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the StateTrigger object.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the StateTrigger object.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns a new state to the StateTrigger object.

methods.name: WaitState
methods.description: Waits until the specified state is reached or the timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitStateClear
methods.description: Waits until the specified state is cleared or the timeout occurs.
